name: Unnamed Greek organized-crime ring (6 suspects in case file; 2 named arrests)
brief: Greece's Financial Crime Squad broke up an organized-crime ring that used AI voice-cloning to impersonate victims' relatives in high-value phone fraud. "Callers" posed as staff of the national electricity distributor (HEDNO) or telecom/fiber providers to obtain a short voice sample of a victim's relative under pretext, then AI-cloned that voice to call the original victim back impersonating the trusted relative to validate fraudulent instructions; "collectors" then physically retrieved cash/valuables. Two suspects (aged 23 and 25) were arrested in Nea Ionia, Attica, caught leaving a victim's home with ~€30,000 in valuables; police estimate total illegal proceeds exceed €1 million across at least 5 documented cases since early July 2026. Euronews
